### Demo code values in text
```{r}
num_students <- 197
num_sections <- 8
num_students_per_section <- num_students / num_sections
```

I can make a paragraph this values in it like this. There are `r num_students` students in this class with `r num_sections` sections. So there are `r num_students_per_section` students per section in this class.
